title: Rav Chinena bar Bisna
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in [Beitzah 22a](https://www.sefaria.org/Beitzah.22a.5), saying: “Here we are dealing with a candelabrum made of segments.” Dikdukei Soferim reads Rabbi Yitzchak bar Bisna, which Hyman gives as the reason Yuchasin did not mention him. Hyman takes [Seder HaDorot’s entry on Chana bar Bizna](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=1378&lang=en) to identify them.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The linked Beitzah names Rav Chinena bar Bisna. Heilprin explicitly makes the identification tentative, writing “perhaps they are one person.”
The Yitzchak reading in Dikdukei Soferim and the explanation of the omission from Yuchasin are Hyman’s reports.
